details:
This is more feedback than a single bug per-se, but something I've noticed for a long time now is that fixes keep disappearing a patch or even a hotfix after they're first implemented like they were never there.  The most recent being the audio placement glitch that caused player audio to suddenly come from right beside one ear has returned out of nowhere, and it's by far not the first time this has happened.
I'm pretty sure the changes to improve avatar and social screen loading disappeared like a day after they were added and never returned due to a hotfix.  There's probably more minor fixes under the hood that have just silently disappeared without being noticed because they didn't break the game when they were overwritten.
The only way this happens is if somewhere in your team's workflow is code based on a stale master is getting into release.   This isn't a witch hunt for "the one bad coder" or anything, all I'm asking is you guys just check your development process for at least the past few builds and see if you can find a consistent point where newer code is accidentally being overwritten by old code.
title: Somewhere in VRChat, a stale master keeps getting into the release build.
